# HWP 5.x test document

`textbox-nested.hwp` is an HWP 5.x file saved by Hancom Office from a synthetic
source: a text box that holds a 4×6 approval table with small nested tables. All of
its text is made up. HanMark uses it to test HWP to HWPX conversion and filling an
HWP 5.x form (R-034).

- Source: the Kordoc repository's `tests/fixtures/textbox-nested/`
  (<https://github.com/chrisryugj/kordoc>).
- Copyright: chrisryugj (Kordoc). License: MIT. See `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- SHA-256: `717b7c505640f97b62b874658d43fa7bfd74ffb8bfe8148e348dc8fa71c4cb02`

The file is test data only. It is not bundled into `main.js`.
